parserDesign.algorithm: last-segment-is-slug: split on colon; require length >= 4; prefix smartfile; scopeType in closed set {jurisdiction, tenant, site}; docSlug = last segment matching ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9._-]*$; scopeId = segments.slice(2, -1).join(':') so colons inside site scopeIds are preserved
parserDesign.jurisdictionRule: when scopeType === jurisdiction, scopeId must match ^[0-9]{5,10}$
parserDesign.oldFormRejection: three-segment smartfile:48021:udc returns null — no alias
reconstructionTrapsReturningNull: smartfile:bafybeig...:udc (CID-looking middle segment with wrong scopeType)

why0080Not0078Rewrite: 0078 and 0079 are merged on origin/main (G-14/G-34) and sit behind operator HOLD for deployment apply. Rewriting merged migration files would fork history and invalidate the already-reviewed 0078/0079 artifacts. 0080 is additive: ADD scope_type/scope_id, DROP NOT NULL on jurisdiction_fips, ADD CHECK and UNIQUE(scope_type, scope_id, doc_slug).
